privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: <0>Catering Control</0> is the software used by the catering company that granted you access to this account to manage its operations. This page explains what data the platform stores and how it is handled.
privacy.rowClientsData: Name, ID document, phone number(s), delivery address(es), contracted plan, and order notes
privacy.rowStaffData: Name, email, role within the team
privacy.rowDriversData: Name, ID document, phone, address, and profile photo (optional)
privacy.s2Intro: The platform may involve two types of images:
privacy.s2a: <0>Delivery proof photo</0> (optional, uploaded by whoever delivers): used to resolve a specific claim about an order. It is automatically deleted after <1>15 days</1>.
privacy.s2b: <0>Payment receipt</0> (when a client renews their plan from the portal): used to verify the payment. It is automatically deleted after <1>15 days</1>.
privacy.s2Note: These images are stored with a unique, randomly generated file name (not a public or searchable list), and can only be accessed from within the platform while they are valid.
privacy.s3: Data is used exclusively to operate the catering service: building delivery routes, calculating plan days consumed, and letting staff and drivers know what to deliver and to whom. It is not sold or shared with third parties outside the company that administers your account.
privacy.s4: Data is stored in a database with access controls per user and per role: every session requires a valid sign-in, and access to one company’s information is separated from that of other companies using the same platform.
privacy.s5: Operational records (clients, plans, delivery history) are kept while the company’s account remains active. Backup images and payment receipts are kept for only 15 days, as explained above.
privacy.s5b: In addition, data of inactive clients is automatically removed from the platform after <0>2 years</0>.
privacy.s6: If you want to review, correct, or request deletion of your personal information, contact directly the catering company that administers your account — they have direct control over that data within the platform.
privacy.s6b: Access, correction, and deletion of your personal data are governed by the data protection legislation applicable in your country (for example, consumer privacy laws of the various countries in Latin America or of US states). To the extent those laws require it, we do not sell your personal information; to exercise any of these rights, contact the company.
privacy.s7: This policy may be updated. Relevant changes will be reflected in the "Last updated" date on this page.
privacy.contact: Questions about this policy? Contact the company that granted you access to this account, or whoever provided you the platform.
privacy.seeTerms: See also the Terms and conditions →

payroll.daysNote: Days show "—" until they are processed from Work Day. Once processed, they remain as a fixed record of that day. Each day's amount is calculated with the rate that driver had ON that day (if the rate changed mid-month, each stretch is paid at its own rate).
payroll.legacyNote: Some days this month were processed before this update and are recalculated with each client's current data (they may not exactly match what was closed that day). Days processed from now on are saved exactly as they were closed.
